headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest revenue expansion and profit pressure.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. AI revenue contributed materially for several companies, boosting margins at HCLTech and deal wins at Mphasis. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at Wipro, indicating cautious outlook. Profitability improved for most, but Wipro and Persistent saw declines.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue growth (Infosys, Mphasis, HCLTech, TCS) posted higher profit margins or larger deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance tightening
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance; Wipro introduced a modest sequential outlook, reflecting uncertainty in macro demand.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%; OFSS posted a 47.8% operating margin, while others remained in the mid‑teens.
